meta.name: render-absurdist-explainer
meta.description: Assemble an absurdist animated-explainer video ad (~38s, 9:16) from per-scene i2v clips + their measured VO windows — retime each clip to its VO, re-encode every segment to identical 30fps/libx264/yuv420p so the concat demuxer never drops frames, concat, build a REAL-product PIL end card (never AI) with a slow Ken-Burns, mix VO (loudnorm I=-14) under music (loudnorm I=-26, volume 0.62, amix normalize=0), and burn libass captions last. FREE deterministic assembly (bash-free, Python + ffmpeg + PIL); the recipe supplies the clips, VO, music, product photo, palette, and caption table and gates the paid keyframe/clip/VO/music calls to their own capabilities. Use for the absurdist-explainer format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将分镜素材自动组装成动画解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从素材自动合成带配音和字幕的动画广告视频。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble animated explainer videos from per-scene clips automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically composite animated ad videos from raw clips with voiceover and captions.

howto.what: 这个技能会自动把一段段视频片段和配音对齐，统一转成30帧每秒的格式，再拼接成一个约38秒的竖屏广告视频。最后它会加上真实产品照片的结尾卡片，混合配音和背景音乐，并烧录字幕。
howto.when: 当你需要制作一个荒诞风格的动画解说广告视频，并且已经准备好了各个场景的视频片段、配音、音乐、产品照片和字幕表时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这些视频片段和配音合成一个荒诞解说广告。
say.note: 技能会按规则自动对齐、转码、拼接并添加结尾卡片。

say.text: 把这段配音和对应的视频片段按测量时长对齐。
say.note: 技能会使用配音的实际时长来调整视频片段长度。

say.text: 给这个广告加上结尾卡片，用真实产品照片。
say.note: 技能会合成包含真实产品照片和品牌文字的结尾卡片。

howto.what_en: This skill automatically aligns video clips with their voiceover, re-encodes everything to 30fps, and assembles a ~38s vertical ad video. It adds a real product photo end card, mixes VO and music, and burns captions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to produce an absurdist animated explainer ad and have prepared per-scene clips, VO, music, product photo, and caption table.

say_en.text: Assemble these clips and VO into an absurdist explainer ad.
say_en.note: The skill will retime, re-encode, concat, and add end card automatically.

say_en.text: Align this VO with its clip using the measured duration.
say_en.note: The skill uses the actual VO length to adjust clip timing.

say_en.text: Add an end card with the real product photo.
say_en.note: The skill composites the real product photo with brand text.
